description: This PHP source file generates the web interface for managing connected devices on a network, including viewing online and offline devices, editing device properties (such as IP configuration), and performing actions like blocking devices or disconnecting Wi-Fi clients. It integrates server-side PHP code with client-side JavaScript for dynamic interactions and displays various device lists with detailed information.

methods.name: ProcessLay1Interface
methods.description: Processes network interface information to determine network type (Private/Public) and connection type (Wi-Fi, Ethernet, MoCA).
